caption: This drawing contains two main elements: an outline sketch of a crock at the top and a more detailed rectangular depiction below it. The crock at the top is drawn in blue ink with simple lines, including two handles and a floral or botanical design on its side. It has the text "A.L.P. NORTON BENNINGTON VT. 1 1/2" written across the upper part of the crock. The larger, rectangular section below features a taupe or light brown shaded background with blue ink designs. Near the top are the words “A L P NORTON BENNINGTON VT.” above the fraction "1 1/2" both in blue lettering. Below this is a large, stylized blue floral or leafy motif, with prominent swirling shapes and small circular dots extending outward. The artist’s signature "Ylande Delsko" appears in the lower left corner of the drawing. The overall composition uses primarily blue and taupe tones on a cream-colored paper background.
title: Crock
